Pulling back reveals curved boundary walls and static ceremonial umbrellas at the gate bases.
Later, two pedestrians emerge near the bottom center and persist, shifting slightly relative to the gate.
The distant small figure on the path beyond the gate stays roughly in place throughout.
caption: An aerial view looks down a straight paved path running between the two weathered halves of a stone Balinese split gate, with misty forested mountains under a low cloud bank in the distance. Manicured lawns flank the path, a white house peeks among trees on the left, and large trees heavy with red blossoms frame both edges. The camera steadily retreats and rises, so the gate towers, whose bases are cut off at the start, gradually shrink and center within the wider frame. As the camera pulls back, the curved boundary walls in front of the gate emerge and red-and-white and yellow ceremonial umbrellas become visible at the gate bases, remaining static. Two pedestrians on the path near the bottom center come into view later and persist, shifting only slightly relative to the gate. The distant small figure on the path beyond the gate stays roughly in place throughout. The foreground flowering trees shift in framing due to the camera's backward motion rather than their own movement.
